key_insight: An F₂-linear hash partitions Pauli strings so a k-qubit channel couples each partition to at most 4^k gate-determined partitions, avoiding global deduplication synchronization.
engineering_relevance: Bounded communication helps pool memory across cores and compute nodes for larger classical simulations of quantum circuits and many-body dynamics.
method: Evolve observables as sparse sums of Pauli strings in the Heisenberg picture.
Partition strings using an F₂-linear hash function.
Apply gates through independent tasks with bounded interpartition communication.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports efficient parallel scaling within and across nodes, simulations exceeding 10^11 Pauli strings, and access to longer many-body dynamics timescales using an open-source implementation.
watch_item: Memory bandwidth and capacity remain constraints, while the 4^k communication bound grows exponentially with channel locality.
